items.title: 家族周排名挑战与20%贡献转移
items.original_rules: 败方20%周贡献转移；拒绝后24小时不能再挑战同一族；挑战小时是占位配置。

evidence_refs.text: Confrim to send forward a Ranking PK? After %s hours since the PK starts, system will compare both Families' weekly rankings. The lower-ranked Family will lose 20%% of own weekly contribution points to the higher-ranked Family.

The Family has accepted your Ranking PK invitation. After %s hours, system will compare both Families' weekly rankings. The lower-ranked Family will lose 20%% of own weekly contribution points to the higher-ranked Family. Invite your Family members to help climb the ranks!
The other Family has declined your Ranking PK invitation. You cannot invite this Family to a PK for another 24 hours, but you can challenge another Family.
Your Family lost the Ranking PK. 20%% of your weekly contribution points were taken by the other Family.

items.reconstruction_choices: 2小时挑战、贡献即排名、向下取整、同分蓝队胜为本地规则。
not_recovered: 排名算法、取整、并列、超时和上限未知。
是否在目标地区/账号开启、真实后台裁决与付费权限未经运行验证。

items.title: 家族召集与成长任务
items.original_rules: 建/入族财富门槛为动态值；全族召集一天一次；另有每日提醒计数；管理员可管理成员。

evidence_refs.text: You need a wealth level ≥%d to create a family. Upgrade your level or try to join a fun family!
You can apply to join this family when you reach the wealth level up to %d
All family members will receive your call and have direct access to your room(There is only one chance to summon a day ~)
All family members will receive your reminder and join the room. (Number of daily reminders left: %1$s/%2$s)
Admins can help you manage the family, kick people out as well. Do you want to set this person as an admin?

items.reconstruction_choices: 财富10、提醒每日2、任务10族EXP为自定；管理员每日召集一次保留文案。
not_recovered: 具体门槛、族等级、人数和提醒数未知。
是否在目标地区/账号开启、真实后台裁决与付费权限未经运行验证。

items.title: 礼物竞拍守护关系
items.original_rules: 赠礼竞价；类型/期限由拍卖师决定；Guests与host不能竞拍；100拍卖值=100守护值；总量达到动态值解锁宝箱。

evidence_refs.text: After the auction starts, send gifts to the auctor to bid
Approach 2: form the guardianship through bidding in an auction venue (the guardianship type and its duration are decided by auctors).
2. 100 auction value in the auction venue = 100 guardian value
Guests cannot join the auction.
The host cannot join the auction.
When the total amount involved in the auction reaches %1$s, the treasure reward will be unlocked.

items.reconstruction_choices: 按累计赠礼比价、宝箱300、同分先蓝；未恢复分成退款，全部虚拟。
not_recovered: 竞价比较、最高价还是累计价、分成、退款、平局未知。

items.title: 守护代币与限期关系升级
items.original_rules: 100币代币=100守护值；可7/30天；拒绝/超时退代币；替换不同类型不合并时长；结束清守护值；守护或Couple Lv3通话免费。

evidence_refs.text: 1. 100 coins of relationship token sent = 100 guardian value
Approach 1: send relationship tokens. Once they accept the tokens, the guardianship can thus be formed (the guardianship duration can be 7 days / 30 days).
They have declined your guardianship invitation. Your token is returned. No relationship is formed.
The guardian application has expired, and the gold coins you spent on purchasing tokens have been returned

You and %1$s currently have a [%2$s] relationship with %3$s days remaining. Do you still want to form a %4$s relationship? If you proceed, the [%4$s] relationship will replace your current [%2$s] relationship. The validity periods will not be combined.
After ending the relationship, both of your guardian value will be cleared.
Calls are free once you start any Guardian relationship with each other
Calls are free once you're Couple Lv.3 with each other

items.reconstruction_choices: 100代币=100守护值；同类型续期累加、异类型覆盖从今日30天；替换价格未知未扣款。
not_recovered: 关系名称全集、等级阈值、续期定价、通话计价未知。

items.title: 双向亮心配对回合
items.original_rules: 双向亮心才成功；礼物可增加配对概率的提示存在；成功动画公布、引导离场，未成功可留席。

evidence_refs.text: Light up ❤ of the player you like, if he/she lights you, you will be paired successfully!
Light up ❤ of the player you like, if he/she lights you, you will be paired successfully! (Tips: giving gifts can increase the probability of pairing)
Successfully paired users will be announced in an animation. If not successful, you can stay in the seat to wait for next game!
After the end, guide the paired players leave the game. Other users can stay for next game. Invite new players to join.
Guide the paired players to play a game of active atmosphere; guide other users to express a blessing to the paired players by sending gifts.

items.reconstruction_choices: 两人互选；礼物只显示未恢复的概率提示，不产生同意；未匹配留席。
not_recovered: 礼物如何影响互选概率、角色人数、性别与隐私呈现未知。
是否在目标地区/账号开启、真实后台裁决与付费权限未经运行验证。

evidence_refs.text: Unable to switch mode while Battle Royale mode is in progress
